sources.snippet:
The retro toy you love, Lite-Brite, has been creating art with light since 1967. Share the nostalgia of your childhood memories and create beautiful works of art with the Lite-Brite Classic! With its vibrant, colorful pegs and iconic light-up board, the retro Lite-Brite Classic is the perfect way to spark creativity. Use the included templates to assemble your art, or inspire imaginations to soar on their own. Then switch between 4 light modes to bring your art to life. Lite-Brite Classic is [...] Classic Lite Brite with colorful pegs, stencils, and box on white background.

# Lite Brite – Lite-Brite Classic – Favorite Retro Toy [...] Product Description

206 Classic Pegs:  
 This set includes 206 glowing pegs in 6 different colors to light up your imagination and inspire creativity!

6 Design Templates:  
 There are 6 easy-to-follow templates included, such as a boat, a unicorn, and more! Use the templates or design your own art – there’s no end to the fun.

4 Different Light Modes:  
 There are 4 different light modes that you can switch between for a fun and brilliant display of your art.
